title: Associate Creative Director
description:
**About Remedy Edge Spain:**



Welcome to Remedy Edge Spain. We activate potential, amplify with creativity, and accelerate outcomes. Remedy Edge brings strategic thinking and bold communications to healthcare — cutting through the noise to move people and change results. We don't do comfortable. We do cutting edge. Join us and GET THE EDGE.


**About the role:**



We are looking for an experienced **Associate Creative Director (ACD)** to join our creative international team. In this role, you will lead the development of integrated healthcare campaigns, partnering with cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative, high\-quality creative solutions from concept through execution.


**Key responsibilities:**


* Develop strong creative concepts and integrated campaigns across multiple channels and formats.
* Lead the creative development of projects from initial concept through final execution, ensuring excellence in both visual and verbal communication.
* Transform complex healthcare and scientific information into clear, engaging, and impactful creative solutions.
* Partner with Creative Directors to define and maintain the creative vision and quality of the work.
* Lead, inspire and mentor creative teams, including art directors, copywriters and designers.
* Provide clear, constructive creative feedback that elevates the overall quality of the work.
* Collaborate closely with Strategy, Account, Medical and Production teams.
* Present and defend creative ideas confidently to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines without compromising creative standards.
* Take ownership of projects, proactively identify challenges and help drive work forward efficiently.


**About you:**



A **creative leader first and foremost**: someone with exceptional conceptual thinking, strong creative instincts, and the ability to recognize, develop and elevate great ideas.



Whether your roots are in **Art, Copy, or both**, you should be comfortable overseeing and guiding all aspects of the creative process, inspiring multidisciplinary teams and taking ownership of projects from concept to execution.



We're looking for someone with the ambition to push the work forward, the creative craft to make it exceptional, and the leadership skills to bring teams along the journey and deliver outstanding results.


**Skills \& Experience**


* **7\-8 years of creative experience in healthcare communications.**
* Strong background in either **Art Direction, Copywriting, or both**, with a portfolio demonstrating outstanding conceptual thinking and creative craft.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns across a variety of channels and touchpoints.
* Strong experience working with pharmaceutical, biotech, medical or health\-related brands.
* **Native\-level English is essential.**
* **Proven ability to lead creative teams and projects.**
* Excellent conceptual thinking, communication and presentation skills.
* Strong expertise in visual storytelling, narrative development, creative strategy and content creation.
* Ability to understand complex scientific information and translate it into compelling creative communications.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Good understanding of healthcare regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Collaborative, proactive and solution\-oriented mindset.

  


*Omnicom Health is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we're focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**
------------------


ElevenReader is our fast\-growing consumer audio app, and creative is one of our biggest growth levers. We’re looking for a Creative Producer to deliver creative marketing campaigns, experiments, and to build the creative engine that powers performance marketing across every major acquisition channel.


This role sits at the intersection of creative design, AI, and performance marketing. You’ll be our lead creative strategist, producing high\-quality creative concepts, building scalable creative workflows using AI tools, developing a testing roadmap, launching experiments across Meta, Google, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms with our Performance Marketing team. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Design, Growth Analytics, and partner agencies to continuously discover which creative drives acquisition at scale, and feeding these insights back into future creative roadmaps.


This is one part strategist and one part creative producer for someone who loves combining exceptional creative taste with rigorous experimentation and marketing results.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Designing creative systems, concepts and templates, mood boards, briefs, and AI workflows that power high\-velocity ad production
* Create visually\-stunning, brand aligned, static ad campaigns end\-to\-end in Figma and ElevenLabs
* Directing agency partners with clear and compelling creative briefs, UGC scripts, storyboards, scripts, and feedback on creative concepts, ensuring the timely and aligned delivery of assets
* Creating and launching creative testing programs across Meta, Google, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging acquisition channels with Performance Marketing and agencies
* Developing a structured creative roadmap with recurring testing sprints and clear learning agendas
* Designing analytical frameworks to identify winning creative patterns using performance data and creative analysis
* Researching and mapping creative trends across competitors, consumer categories, and best\-in\-class mobile apps to generate new hypotheses for testing
* Partnering closely with Performance Marketing and agencies to rapidly iterate and scale winning campaigns
* Continuously improving our creative production pipeline through AI automation, reusable templates, and scalable workflows
* Analyzing which creative is resonating most with our audience through ad platforms and tools like Motion
* Raising the creative quality bar while ensuring every asset is designed to maximize measurable business outcomes

**Requirements**
----------------

* 5\+ years of experience in performance creative, art direction, growth marketing, creative strategy, or design at a high\-growth consumer product or technology company
* Deep expertise with generative AI for image and video creation, with a strong understanding of how to build repeatable creative workflows with tools like ElevenCreative
* Experience creating high\-performing ads across Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, or other major paid acquisition platforms
* Experience with creative performance analytics tools like Motion
* Strong understanding of creative experimentation, performance marketing, A/B testing, and data\-driven optimization
* Expert proficiency in Figma, CapCut, Adobe Suite and modern AI creative tools and generative media platforms
* Exceptional visual taste with the ability to balance speed, quality, and brand consistency
* Deep understanding of user psychology and what drives successful consumer marketing
* Highly analytical and structured thinker who enjoys building experimentation frameworks and extracting insights from data
* Self\-directed builder who thrives in fast\-moving environments and can independently take ideas from concept to launch

**Bonus**
---------

* Power user of ElevenCreative, including Flows and Templates
* Background in building AI\-powered creative production systems or internal creative tooling
* Passion for consumer products, AI, storytelling, and building globally loved brands.

**Location**
------------


This role is remote with a preference for timezones in US \- East and Europe

title: Senior UA Creative Strategist - Mobile Games
description:
The Role
We are looking for a sharp, highly curious **UA Creative Strategist** to help us decide what advertising creatives we should make and why.


This is not primarily a video editing or art production role. Your job is to stay ahead of the mobile games advertising market, spot emerging creative opportunities, understand what is working and what is becoming stale, and turn those insights into strong concepts and clear production briefs.


You will sit at the intersection of **creative, user acquisition, games and data**.


We want someone who watches the market closely, studies competitors, understands internet culture and short\-form video, experiments aggressively, and is constantly asking:

**“What should we test next?”**


You will work with our UA team and with internal and external creators, editors, artists, AI tools and production partners to turn those ideas into ads.  

What You’ll Do


Own Our UA Creative Direction* Develop a continuous pipeline of new video ad concepts, hooks, formats and creative hypotheses.
* Decide which ideas are worth producing and testing based on market trends, player psychology, competitor activity and our own performance data.
* Build a weekly creative roadmap rather than waiting for production requests.
* Push beyond obvious variations of existing ads and actively search for new creative angles.


Hunt for Trends and Creative Opportunities* Constantly research mobile game advertising across TikTok, Meta, YouTube, AppLovin, Google, Unity, Mintegral and emerging channels.
* Study successful ads from both direct competitors and completely different genres and industries.
* Deconstruct winning creatives by looking at the hook, pacing, storytelling structure, gameplay, visual treatment, sound, creator style, emotional trigger and CTA.
* Track broader TikTok, Reels, Shorts, creator and internet culture trends and identify which ones can be translated into performance advertising.
* Maintain a living library of interesting ads, formats, hooks and creative patterns.


Turn Insights Into Things We Can Actually Make* Write clear, production\-ready creative briefs, scripts, storyboards and references.
* Explain not just **what** to make, but the hypothesis behind the idea and what we are trying to learn.
* Give strong creative direction and feedback to video editors, motion designers, game capture teams, UGC creators, AI creators and external agencies.
* Help producers and artists understand the intent of a concept without prescribing every frame.
* Review work in progress and push execution until the original creative idea comes through clearly.


Build a Modern Creative Testing Machine* Work closely with UA managers to understand CTR, IPM, CVR, CPI, ROAS, retention and other creative performance signals.
* Identify why a creative worked rather than simply declaring it a winner.
* Turn winning ads into structured families of new hypotheses rather than endless minor variations.
* Kill weak directions quickly and double down aggressively when a concept shows promise.
* Watch for creative fatigue and ensure the pipeline always has genuinely fresh ideas entering testing.


Use AI Aggressively, but Intelligently* Stay current with AI image, video, voice, scripting and editing tools.
* Use AI to prototype ideas, explore concepts and generate variations rapidly.
* Understand where AI production is good enough, where human production is better, and when the two should be combined.
* Experiment with AI\-native formats and workflows rather than treating AI only as a cheaper production tool.
* Help us continuously evaluate new creative tools, platforms and production partners.


Direct External Production* Identify and brief specialist agencies, UGC creators, freelance editors, AI studios and playable ad providers when appropriate.
* Evaluate external creative partners based on performance, speed and creative thinking, not simply production polish.
* Give vendors decisive feedback and keep projects moving.
* Help us build a flexible production network capable of executing very different kinds of ideas quickly.


Creative Formats You Should Be Comfortable With
You do not need to personally produce all of these, but you should understand how and when to use them:

* Gameplay\-led video
* TikTok, Reels and Shorts\-native ads
* UGC and creator\-style ads
* Gameplay reviews and reaction formats
* Narrative and story\-driven ads
* Failure, challenge and transformation formats
* Humor, memes and culturally relevant concepts
* AI\-generated and AI\-assisted video
* 2D and 3D animation
* Live action
* Playable and interactive ads
* Static and lightweight motion concepts
* We care much more about **choosing the right format for the idea** than having a preferred production style


What This Role Is Not
This is **not** a traditional brand Creative Director role.


It is **not** primarily a video editor position.


It is also **not** a UA media buying position.


We are hiring the person who sits between those disciplines. This person is responsible for understanding the market, generating the hypotheses, choosing the creative directions, briefing the people who make them, and learning from the results.


What Success Looks Like
You have created a repeatable rhythm where we always know:

**What are we testing? Why are we testing it? What did we learn? What should we make next?**


Over time, we should see a larger and more diverse pipeline of strong creative ideas, faster learning cycles, more creative winners, less dependence on a small number of exhausted concepts, and better UA performance as a result.


Above all, we want someone who develops a reputation inside the company for constantly bringing us ideas we would not have thought of ourselves.

 **Requirements**  

  

What We’re Looking For* Around **3 to 5 years of relevant experience** in mobile games, mobile apps, performance creative, creative strategy, advertising or a closely related field.
* Strong understanding of mobile game UA creative and performance advertising.
* Exceptional instinct for short\-form video, including hooks, pacing, storytelling, visual communication and attention.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort interpreting creative performance data.
* Ability to look at an advertisement and explain *why* it works.
* Ability to turn insights into clear creative hypotheses and actionable briefs.
* Deep curiosity about games, advertising, internet culture, creators and emerging formats.
* Strong familiarity with current generative AI creative tools and workflows.
* Excellent communication and creative feedback skills.
* High initiative. You should naturally research, experiment and bring us ideas without waiting to be asked.
* Comfortable challenging existing assumptions when you believe there is a better direction.


Nice to Have* Previous mobile game Creative Strategist or Creative Producer experience.
* Experience with casual or hybrid\-casual games.
* Experience working directly with Meta, TikTok, Google or major mobile ad networks.
* Familiarity with creative intelligence tools such as Sensor Tower, AppMagic, Apptica, Meta Ads Library or TikTok’s creative tools.
* Experience briefing and managing UGC creators or external creative agencies.
* Knowledge of playable ads.
* Basic hands\-on ability with CapCut, Premiere, After Effects or similar tools.
* Ability to quickly make a rough edit, AI prototype or visual mockup to communicate an idea.
* Game capture, Unity or other game development familiarity.

  

**Benefits**  

* Market competitive, tax\-free USD salaries
* Paid Time Off
* Performance Bonus
* Annual Performance Reviews

title: Creative Producer
description:
**TheSoul Group** is a leading creator business platform positioned at the heart of the creator economy. Our original videos, animations, and editorial stories inspire audiences in **21 languages**, across **60 platforms** and **20 websites**.


Together with our network of **talented creators**, we reach over **5 billion followers** and generate more than **100 billion monthly views** on social media.


As a global powerhouse in digital media, we drive viral success for creators and brands worldwide through a wide range of services, leveraging our expertise in content distribution, localization, and social media management. We’re the creators behind global phenomena such as **5\-Minute Crafts** and **BrightSide**.


We’re a dynamic, remote\-first global team, fostering award\-winning creativity, a no\-red\-tape approach, and great vibes!


We are looking for a **Creative Producer** to help shape and oversee the creative direction of original YouTube shows for a globally recognized beauty brand.


In this role, you will help define the creative vision, develop distinctive and engaging formats, and ensure that each show aligns with the overall channel strategy, brand positioning, and audience ambition.


You will work closely with an external production agency responsible for execution, providing creative guidance throughout the process, challenging and refining ideas, reviewing key creative decisions, and ensuring the final output stays true to the agreed vision and strategy.


A strong understanding of YouTube, internet culture, creators, and emerging subcultures is essential. Experience in beauty, fashion, or lifestyle is an advantage, but not a requirement.

 **Requirements**  

* Strong experience developing and leading large\-scale entertainment shows for YouTube, with a proven track record of delivering high\-profile, audience\-driven formats.
* Deep understanding of YouTube formats, audience behavior, storytelling, and creator culture.
* Strong creative and editorial judgment, with the ability to critically assess, challenge, and improve concepts and formats.
* Experience overseeing external production agencies, studios, or other creative partners.
* Hands\-on experience reviewing creative work across concept development, casting, scripts, visual direction, and edits.
* Strong understanding of internet culture, emerging trends, online communities, creators, and subcultures.
* Ability to balance creative ambition with brand strategy, guidelines, and wider business objectives.
* Experience developing content for international or multi\-market audiences is highly desirable.
* Experience within beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or adjacent consumer categories is a plus, but not essential.

  

**Benefits**  

* **Flexible Engagement Structure:** This opportunity is offered under an independent service\-provider agreement, giving you the freedom to shape how you deliver your expertise. You define your own working methods, organise your schedule independently, and contribute your skills to clearly scoped projects. Compensation is agreed individually and reflects your experience, capabilities, and the value you bring to each engagement.
* **Location Freedom:** You can deliver services from any suitable location that supports high\-quality outcomes, whether that’s your home office, a co\-working space, or wherever you feel most productive and inspired. What matters most is the impact you create and the reliability of your delivery.
* **Global Network and Inspiring Projects:** You’ll collaborate with a diverse international network of professionals across 85\+ countries, contributing to projects that reach vast audiences and help shape the future of digital content. This is an opportunity to work alongside talented specialists, exchange ideas, and be part of meaningful initiatives with real global reach.
* **Smooth Collaboration and Project Support:** To enable efficient service delivery, we provide modern collaboration platforms, clear project coordination, and streamlined processes. This helps you focus your energy where it matters most, producing high\-impact work and bringing creative solutions to life.
* **Make a Global Impact:** Your expertise will contribute to initiatives that influence audiences worldwide. Join projects that push creative boundaries and help build the next generation of digital experiences.

title: Ad Creative Producer
description:
**About us**
============


Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer\-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about\-us/

**About the role**
==================


About the role. We are seeking a talented and innovative **Ad Creative Producer** to join the creative team of one of Ruby Labs’ fastest\-growing consumer products, advertising at high volume on **Meta, Snapchat, and Google**. This full\-time role is central to driving our advertising creative process. You will be responsible for producing **high\-quality ad creatives** — both from briefs provided by the Lead Creative Producer and from your own ideas — managing production timelines, and collaborating with various teams to ensure that our creatives not only captivate but also convert. As a key player in the ad production lifecycle, you will work directly under the Lead Creative Producerand maintain close coordination with User Acquisition Managers to refine and optimize our creatives based on performance data.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Creative Production \& Development**
--------------------------------------

* Produce high\-quality ad creatives end\-to\-end — statics, video, and AI\-generated formats — executing briefs from the Lead Creative Producer to a high standard.
* Contribute your own ideas: lead the ideation and conceptualization of new ad creatives that resonate with diverse audiences, with an emphasis on strategies that enhance customer acquisition.
* Stay ahead of industry trends to integrate innovative elements into creative production, ensuring our creatives are captivating and effectively convert viewers into customers.
* Collaborate with the design team to transform ideas into compelling ad creatives that align with brand values and effectively meet campaign goals.

**Project Management**
----------------------

* Oversee your production pipeline to ensure all creatives are delivered on time and meet the creative vision, with particular attention to optimizing the impact on customer acquisition.
* Coordinate with designers, the Lead Creative Producer, and User Acquisition Managers to ensure smooth workflow and high\-quality outputs.

**Performance Analysis**
------------------------

* Work closely with User Acquisition Managers to analyze the performance of ad creatives across Meta, Snapchat, and Google, identifying those that best contribute to customer acquisition.
* Provide regular reports to the Lead Creative Producer on the impact and effectiveness of ad creatives, highlighting their role in driving customer acquisition.

**Market and Competitor Analysis**
----------------------------------

* Conduct thorough competitor research to understand market benchmarks and creative standards, particularly those successful in acquiring customers.
* Identify emerging trends in ad creative production and propose innovative solutions to leverage these trends for better market positioning and customer engagement.

**Collaborative Efforts**
-------------------------

* Liaise between creative teams and User Acquisition Managers to ensure that ad creatives are optimized for performance based on real\-time data.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions that encourage a culture of creativity and continuous improvement, aimed at boosting customer acquisition and retention.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Experience**
--------------

* Proven **hands\-on experience producing ad creatives for Meta, Snapchat, and Google**.
* Proven track record of managing creative projects from inception to completion.
* **Strong portfolio** demonstrating expertise in producing high\-performing digital ads.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* **Working knowledge of Meta and Google advertising policies** — you know what content gets flagged (misleading design elements, restricted categories, prohibited claims) and produce creatives that stay compliant by default.
* **Expertise in digital advertising platforms** and understanding of **performance metrics.**
* Proficiency in project management tools and collaboration software.
* Ability to perform **data analysis** to draw actionable insights from campaign results.
* Up\-to\-date knowledge of **AI tools** used in creative production, with the ability to leverage them effectively to generate innovative ad creatives.

**Personal Qualities**
----------------------

* Strong creative vision with the ability to think out of the box and challenge the status quo.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Adaptability**
----------------

* Ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and changes in the digital marketing landscape.
* Willingness to experiment with new creative ideas and approaches to advertising.

**Location**
============


Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Benefits**
============


Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work\-life balance.
* **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well\-being, without counting days.
* **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
* **Company\-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top\-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
* **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab\=t.0\#heading\=h.ndsdl4wapxtt


Be part of our fast\-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

**Interview Process**
=====================


After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

* Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
* Take\-Home Assignment
* Technical Interview (60 minutes)
* Final Interview (45 minutes)

**Life at Ruby Labs**
=====================


At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.


This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.


Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer (Generative AI Engineer)
description:
Job Description
  
**Why Avanade? Because there’s literally no place like this**

We have two parent companies that give us a strong Microsoft ecosystem with space to be ourselves. People who thrive here are motivated, interested in learning and genuinely have a desire to be the best at what they do. If that sounds like you, then we’re the perfect match. You will have the opportunity to utilize the most advanced technology within the Microsoft ecosystem, collaborating with some of the world's largest and most renowned companies, as well as working alongside highly intelligent individuals. This environment allows you to make a significant impact on your career trajectory. If you are looking to enhance your skills and drive transformation within businesses, there is no better place to be.


**The EME AI Delivery Hub**

AI—and particularly **Generative AI** —is expected to profoundly impact every company over the coming years. Thanks to Microsoft and Avanade’s strategic investments in AI and OpenAI, we are uniquely positioned to help our clients become **AI\-first organizations** .


The **EME AI Delivery Hub** is an Iberia\-based nearshore delivery center serving European and Middle Eastern clients, specialized in end\-to\-end AI and Advanced Analytics solutions. By joining the Hub, you will be part of a delivery pod working in an agile setup, owning AI initiatives from **problem framing and data exploration to model development, deployment, and adoption** . You will work closely with clients, guiding them throughout their AI and GenAI transformation journey.


**Job Overview**

As a **Senior Analyst – AI \& Data Science** , you will design, develop, and deliver AI\- and data\-driven solutions that help our clients achieve measurable business outcomes. This role combines **strong Data Science foundations** with **hands\-on AI engineering** , including recent GenAI use cases.


You will work across the full data science lifecycle: **data exploration, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, and deployment** , while also contributing to modern AI solutions such as **LLM\-based applications, NLP, computer vision, and predictive analytics** , primarily on **Microsoft Azure** .


**Key Role Responsibilities**

**Day\-to\-day you will:**

* Design and deliver **end\-to\-end Data Science and AI solutions** , from business understanding and data exploration to model deployment and monitoring.
* Perform **exploratory data analysis (EDA)** , feature engineering, and data preprocessing on structured and unstructured datasets.
* Develop, train, evaluate, and optimize **machine learning and deep learning models** , selecting appropriate algorithms and validation strategies.
* Contribute to **Generative AI solutions** , including LLM\-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and applied NLP use cases.
* Translate business problems into analytical and ML formulations, clearly explaining trade\-offs and results to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Support the preparation of **client presentations, demos, and proposals** , articulating analytical insights and AI\-driven value.
* Stay up to date with the latest advancements in **Data Science, ML, DL, and GenAI** , and actively share knowledge within the team.
* Contribute to reusable assets such as **code templates, analytical frameworks, and internal training materials** .
* Collaborate with senior team members and architects to identify opportunities where advanced analytics and AI can transform client operations.

  
Qualification
  
**Key Role Skill \& Capability Requirements**

**Core Skills**

title: Diseñador Principal de Experiencia de Usuario
Social Art Director & Videographer - Madrid
description:
**¿Quiénes somos?**
-------------------


Somos una consultora internacional especializada en impulsar la evolución de los modelos de negocio de grandes y medianas empresas. Ayudamos a nuestros clientes a mejorar su competitividad conectando estrategia, comunicación, diseño, tecnología y datos, siempre con un enfoque práctico y orientado a generar impacto.


Contamos con un equipo de más de 2\.000 profesionales distribuidos en distintos países y trabajamos en proyectos end\-to\-end, acompañando a nuestros clientes desde la definición estratégica hasta la implementación, la medición y la optimización continua. Nuestro objetivo es transformar los datos en decisiones de negocio que generen resultados reales.


En esta ocasión, estamos colaborando con **Cosmic**, una empresa del grupo, en la búsqueda de talento para incorporar a su equipo y cubrir esta posición.

**¿Qué es Cosmic?**
-------------------

**Cosmic** es una agencia especializada en **Short Vertical Video**, el formato que domina plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts. Como primer partner creativo de TikTok en Europa, ayuda a las marcas a conectar con sus audiencias a través de contenidos nativos, creativos y diseñados para maximizar su impacto.


Su equipo se encarga de diseñar, producir y optimizar contenidos que destacan en las plataformas donde hoy se generan las conversaciones y las tendencias, combinando creatividad, estrategia y un profundo conocimiento del ecosistema digital.

### **¿Qué buscamos?**

**¿Sabes que un buen TikTok no es un spot de 30 segundos puesto en vertical?**


Buscamos un/a **Social Art Director \& Videographer** con un ojo creativo brutal y una sensibilidad especial por el lenguaje de cada plataforma. Alguien que entienda qué hace que una idea funcione en social y que sea capaz de llevarla de principio a fin: **conceptualizarla, grabarla, editarla y convertirla en contenido que la gente quiera ver y compartir.**


No buscamos solo a alguien que sepa hacer vídeos bonitos. Buscamos a alguien que **entienda el lenguaje de internet, tenga criterio visual y sepa convertir una buena idea en contenido que funcione.**

### **Eres perfecto/a si**

* **Tienes 3\+ años de experiencia** en dirección de arte, diseño creativo o creación audiovisual, idealmente en agencia creativa, digital, productora o entorno social\-first.
* **Tu portfolio habla por ti.** Demuestra criterio visual, buenas ideas y, sobre todo, capacidad real para llevarlas a ejecución.
* **Tienes obsesión por el detalle.** Composición, fotografía, tipografía, color, ritmo… sabes que son los pequeños detalles los que hacen que una pieza pase de correcta a memorable.
* **Piensas en movimiento desde el principio.** No diseñas primero una pieza gráfica para convertirla después en vídeo: piensas en imagen, cámara, ritmo y narrativa desde el minuto uno.
* **Entiendes el lenguaje de cada plataforma.** Sabes que lo que funciona en TikTok no necesariamente funciona en Instagram o YouTube, y adaptas la idea sin perder su esencia.
* **Te mueves bien entre lo grande y lo rápido.** Puedes trabajar en una producción con todos los recursos o sacar adelante una pieza que tiene que estar publicada mañana.
* **Eres resourceful.** No necesitas una gran producción para hacer algo bueno: sabes sacar partido a un móvil, un equipo pequeño y los recursos que tengas a mano.
* **Eres proactivo/a.** Traes referencias, detectas tendencias, propones formatos y encuentras oportunidades incluso cuando nadie te ha dado todavía un brief.

### **¿Qué harás?**

* **Convertir ideas en contenido.** Conceptualizar y desarrollar ideas visuales y audiovisuales para campañas, contenido always\-on y oportunidades culturales en social.
* **Marcar la dirección visual.** Definir el look \& feel de contenidos y activaciones, construyendo una identidad reconocible sin caer en fórmulas o plantillas repetitivas.
* **Dar forma a las ideas.** Crear tratamientos visuales, referencias, moodboards, storyboards y planteamientos de realización que hagan que una idea cobre vida antes de llegar a producción.
* **Grabar y producir.** Coger una cámara o un smartphone y sacar adelante una pieza de principio a fin, adaptando los recursos a lo que necesita cada idea.
* **Resolver en modo social\-first.** Desde entrevistas y producto hasta creators, coberturas, contenido reactivo y formatos que necesitan salir rápido. Sabes moverte con soltura cuando el contexto cambia.
* **Editar y llevar las piezas hasta el final.** Montaje, ritmo, grafismo, motion, sonido y color, cuidando tanto el conjunto como cada detalle.
* **Pensar en cada plataforma.** Adaptar conceptos y piezas para TikTok, Reels, Stories, Shorts, YouTube, LinkedIn y otros formatos digitales, entendiendo qué funciona en cada entorno.
* **Trabajar pegado al equipo de contenido.** Colaborar con Content Manager y Social Intelligence para convertir tendencias, insights y oportunidades editoriales en ideas visuales que merezca la pena producir.
* **Experimentar con IA.** Incorporar herramientas generativas en tu proceso de ideación, preproducción y exploración visual, trabajando junto al AI Content Producer cuando la pieza requiera workflows más complejos.
* **Sacar lo mejor de los creators.** Dirigir a personas delante de cámara de forma natural, ágil y sin convertir cada grabación en un rodaje de película.
* **Defender tus ideas.** Presentar y argumentar conceptos y decisiones visuales ante equipos internos y clientes, sabiendo explicar no solo qué propones, sino por qué funciona.

### **Lo que tienes que dominar**

* **Portfolio con criterio.** Experiencia demostrable en creatividad social y audiovisual, con piezas que demuestren tanto buen ojo como capacidad de ejecución.
* **Cámara y móvil.** Capacidad profesional para grabar con cámara y smartphone, sabiendo elegir el equipo y el enfoque según lo que necesite cada pieza.
* **Lenguaje audiovisual.** Conocimientos sólidos de fotografía, composición, iluminación, encuadre, movimiento y narrativa audiovisual.
* **Herramientas de creación.** Dominio de Adobe Creative Cloud —Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere y After Effects— y soltura con herramientas ágiles como CapCut.
* **Código social.** Conocimiento profundo de formatos, duraciones, hooks, ritmo y códigos visuales y narrativos de TikTok, Instagram/Reels y YouTube/Shorts.
* **IA aplicada a la creatividad.** Familiaridad con herramientas de IA generativa y criterio para incorporarlas en la ideación, preproducción y producción audiovisual cuando realmente aporten valor.

**Cómo trabajas**
-----------------

* **Piensas y haces a la vez.** Te gusta conceptualizar, pero también coger la cámara, probar, grabar y resolver. No eres de los que se quedan en la idea.
* **Sabes que manda la plataforma.** Entiendes sus códigos, su ritmo y lo que hace que una pieza funcione en cada canal. No haces “un vídeo y luego lo adaptas”: piensas nativamente para cada plataforma.
* **Encuentras el equilibrio.** Sabes mantener la identidad de marca sin perder relevancia cultural ni convertir cada contenido en una pieza demasiado corporativa.
* **Eres proactivo/a.** Traes referencias, detectas tendencias, propones formatos y encuentras oportunidades sin esperar a que llegue un brief perfectamente cerrado.

**¿Te gustaría crecer con nosotros/as?**
----------------------------------------


Si buscas un entorno donde la creatividad, la comunicación y la estrategia se unen para generar un impacto real en el negocio, esta puede ser tu oportunidad.


En esta ocasión, te incorporarás a **Cosmic**, una empresa del grupo, donde formarás parte de un equipo que está redefiniendo la forma en la que las marcas conectan con sus audiencias a través del contenido en plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts.


Si te apasionan los retos, la innovación y el entorno digital, ¡queremos conocerte!


En línea con nuestro compromiso con la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión, animamos a todas las personas a presentar su candidatura, especialmente a quienes forman parte de colectivos tradicionalmente infrarrepresentados, como las personas LGTBIQ\+ o las personas con discapacidad.

title: Head of Design, AI-First
description:
**Own the design function for a $1Billion\+ brand. Transform how we build with AI.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $181,500 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path** 
 from here is VP Design → Chief Design Officer. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere can happen in 1\-2 years here for high performers.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every design proposal ships with an AI review link, and Figma AI runs in our live production pipeline, shipping real work. You'd start where most teams are still trying to get.
 



  





*This position is remote, with the option to work from our Dubai office (with 0% income tax), if preferred (relocation and visa sponsorship support available).* 




  





**Role Overview** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Head of Design to turn our end\-to\-end web design from a sequential production queue into a fast, AI\-native operation. You will build on our existing AI adoption by establishing consistent workflows, prompt infrastructure, quality controls and system governance that let high\-quality design work ship at volume without extending timelines. While you own the visual and structural execution of the site, you will partner closely with the CRO team, which owns experimentation, including test hypotheses and the conversion roadmap.
 



  





**The Career Accelerator** 




 You will have the rare opportunity to take on a broad scope of work with unmatched autonomy.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce:** 
 very few Heads of Design get simultaneous ownership over the design system, the AI toolchain, the design roadmap and accessibility standards while leading a team of three as a hands\-on player coach and reporting directly to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion. This is not a role where you just review other people's mockups and forward them to engineering. Instead, you are building the operating system for the entire design function.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 rebuild the design workflow from sequential to agile, with kickoff huddles and a 40% reduction in time from design concept to development handoff. Build the prompt library and review workflow covering product copy, FAQs, size/fit guidance, policy explainers, and localized variants. Design the UI patterns for conversational search, guided finders, and PDP Q\&A alongside engineering. Own the recommendation surfaces — placements, card density, "why this" microcopy — and validate them with staged rollouts. Evolve the design system so tokens and components absorb AI\-generated variants without brand drift or PageSpeed cost. Bake WCAG 2\.2 into the system and pair AI\-assisted audits with manual review. Feed the experimentation roadmap with design variants that the CRO team can test at pace, and turn winning patterns into reusable standards across the design system. Shape the future of design at Puffy, where the site is the entire storefront and every conversion point runs through your team.



  





**What Is In It For You** 




 This isn't just another design management role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Design Function and the Toolchain It Runs On** 




 You set the standard, build the workflow, and own what ships.
 


* You design the operating model for the whole function: how work enters the queue, how AI\-generated variants get validated, where human QA sits, and how a spec reaches Dev Mode without losing intent. You own IA, wireframes, high\-fidelity comps, prototypes, and motion specs across Home, PLP, PDP, Cart/Checkout, editorial, and paid\-media landing pages. You decide what the design system tolerates and what it rejects.
* You hold the line on WCAG 2\.2, PageSpeed, and brand consistency while the volume goes up. You’re accountable for design quality, delivery speed, and the design team's contribution to conversion lift. You report to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion, present quarterly design roadmap reviews and translate design decisions \& experiment results into a narrative that the business acts on.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 




 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
 



 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
 



 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space or our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Design Leader Other Brands Come Looking For** 




 In most companies, design leaders inherit a workflow somebody else built and spend their tenure defending its timelines in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides what ships next quarter, your design roadmap is the input to that decision, not a status report on it afterwards. You'll leave with an AI\-native design operation you designed end to end — and the handoff\-time and conversion numbers proving quality held while volume went up, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than a versioning queue in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need** 



* 7\+ years in web design for e\-commerce, including 4\+ years leading, mentoring, and managing the operations of a design team.

* Expert in Figma (components, variables, Dev Mode); strong visual/motion craft and responsive design sensibility.

**Good\-to\-Have**

**The Puffy DNA:**

* **Be the Owner:**

title: Creative Director, Copy
description:
**About The Team**
 OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood as it leaves the lab and meets the world.
   

  

 This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for an experienced Creative Director, Copy to join our growing in\-house creative team focused on OpenAI’s business audiences. In this role, you’ll help define how we communicate the value of OpenAI to organizations \- from growing businesses and startups to global enterprises and developers building with our technology.
   

  

 You’ll concept and write across integrated campaigns, product launches, customer stories, events, and other brand moments. You’ll translate complex products, technical capabilities, and business outcomes into clear, compelling ideas that resonate with decision\-makers, builders, and teams adopting AI.
   

  

 This is a deeply hands\-on role for someone who is equally comfortable developing a big campaign platform, shaping a messaging framework, writing a film script, or refining a headline. You’ll work closely with design, production, product marketing, and communications from the earliest stages of an idea through execution.
   

  

 To us, creativity is a team sport. Ideas get better when you talk them through and build on each other’s thinking. We value curiosity over certainty, kindness over ego, and the ability to balance creative ambition with clarity and decisiveness.
   

  

 This role is based in New York, NY. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.
   

  

**In this role you will**
* Concept and write integrated brand campaigns for OpenAI’s business audiences
* Translate complex products, technical capabilities, and use cases into clear, human, and emotionally resonant stories
* Develop campaign platforms, messaging frameworks, headlines, scripts, manifestos, and narrative systems
* Create work that connects OpenAI’s products to meaningful business challenges and outcomes
* Shape how OpenAI speaks to business leaders, technical decision\-makers, developers, and teams adopting AI
* Write across customer stories, product launches, films, digital experiences, events, social content, and executive communications
* Partner closely with design, motion, production, brand strategy, and agency teams to bring ideas to life
* Collaborate with Product Marketing, Sales, Product, Communications, and other partners to understand audiences and business priorities
* Build flexible messaging systems that can work across industries, audiences, markets, and channels
* Evolve and steward OpenAI’s voice and tone across business communications
* Present creative ideas and explain the thinking behind them to cross\-functional partners and senior stakeholders
* Move fluidly between high\-level concepts and detailed execution, staying close to the work throughout the process
* Manage multiple complex projects, evolving inputs, and compressed timelines with clarity and confidence
* Help challenge conventions about what enterprise and technology marketing can look and sound like


**You might thrive in this role if you**
* Have 10\+ years of experience writing for brands, gained at a creative agency known for creative excellence and/or in\-house at a modern technology company, with experience in both strongly preferred
* Are an exceptional writer and conceptual thinker with a portfolio of distinctive, integrated creative work
* Have experience writing for B2B, enterprise, developer, or other technically sophisticated audiences

description:
**Our mission**
 We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
   

  

 In 2017, over half the population in Sub\-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
   

  

 We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer\-to\-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
   

  

 Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

 that ignite the emotion of sport through industry\-leading sports video games,
   

  

 including Madden NFL and College Football , FC soccer, NHL hockey, and
   

  

 EA SPORTS UFC .
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Experience Design Lead (Creative Director) is the vision\-holder for how fans interact with the future of EA SPORTS, reporting to the Sr. Director of EA SPORTS Network. Serving as the design and user\-experience anchor of the Network leadership team, this leader is responsible for transforming complex, shared platform and network capabilities into intuitive, memorable, and high\-fidelity consumer experiences.
   

  

 Rather than focusing on a single franchise or product, this role defines the design principles, reusable experience systems, and connected fan journeys that weave individual games (such as Madden NFL, FC, and College Football) into a cohesive, immersive EA SPORTS ecosystem. This role will be a visionary design leader who can establish and scale the Experience Design function for SPORTS Network, instill a design\-centric culture across the team, and champion design innovation in partnership with studios and design partners within EA SPORTS.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 Experience Strategy:
   

  

* Ecosystem Experience Vision: Define the long\-term, multi\-platform vision for a connected EA SPORTS experiences, spanning console, mobile, web, and companion applications.
* Consumer\-First Design Principles: Translate strategic growth objectives into high\-caliber consumer experience principles that put the fan journey at the center.
* Ecosystem Roadmaps: Author and drive long\-term experience design roadmaps that anticipate and support future portfolio growth and platform capabilities.


**Connected Fan Experiences**
* Unified Journeys: Map and refine end\-to\-end fan journeys that connect multiple EA SPORTS experiences, standardizing how identity, personalization, recognition, commerce, and community are experienced.
* Scalable Design Systems: Establish, govern, and continuously evolve scalable design systems, UI/UX toolkits, and reusable interaction models across the portfolio.
* Preserve Franchise Identity: Balance the need for network\-wide experience consistency with the unique, highly branded visual identity of individual sports franchises.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* The Leadership Triad: Partner directly with the Sr. Director of Product Management and Technical Director to build a user\-centered development lifecycle where design, technology, and business goals align.
* Experience Workshops: Lead collaborative experience workshops and build alignment around shared consumer experiences across different team boundaries.
* Influence without Authority: Guide design direction and build consensus across disparate teams, studios, and brand partners through collaboration rather than direct authority.


**Experience Innovation \& Data Informed Design**
* Emerging Interactions: Explore and prototype next\-generation interaction models, including AI\-enabled personalization, spatial design, and real\-time sports feed integrations.
* Data\-Informed Iteration: leverage user research, player data, and run experience design workflows to continuously iterate and elevate experiences.


**Your Qualifications**
* Experience: 10\+ years of experience leading UX, Product Design, Experience Design, or Creative Direction for world\-class, large\-scale digital consumer ecosystems or entertainment products.
* Ecosystem Design: A strong portfolio demonstrating the creation of unified, multi\-platform design systems and seamless consumer journeys across web, mobile, and console.
* Experience leveraging AI in prototyping and creative or design concepting.
* Strategic Execution: Proven ability to balance high\-level creative strategy with operational execution and governance.
* Tooling \& Workflows: Mastery of Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, advanced prototyping tools, and modern collaborative design workflows.
* Storytelling: Exceptional executive storytelling, visual communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of building alignment through influence.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or equivalent experience.

 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

title: Creative Director
description:
As a
 **Creative Director,** 
 you will turn complex business goals into compelling creative ideas. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, lead client conversations, and create the clarity people need to do their best work. You will also use AI thoughtfully to support research, exploration, and workflow efficiency while keeping strategy, judgment, and final approval human\-led.
 



  





 Designity is a premium, AI\-enabled and human\-led Creative\-as\-a\-Service company. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director\-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI\-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 Our clients are managing ambitious business goals, changing priorities, and creative needs that span brands, campaigns, digital experiences, motion, and content.
 



  





 They need more than strong execution. They need a senior creative leader who can find the strategic opportunity, establish a clear direction, assemble the right team, and protect quality from the first conversation through final delivery.
 



  





**What you will be doing** 



* **Set the creative vision** 
 \- Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and project types, including brand platforms, campaigns, visual identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Turn business goals into creative opportunities** 
 \- Find the human and strategic insight behind the brief. Translate it into focused, emotionally resonant concepts that support the client’s objectives.
* **Guide the right creative team** 
 \- Help shape and lead multidisciplinary teams based on the needs of the client, brand, and assignment.
* **Conduct Quality Control \& Protect the standard** 
 \- Review concepts and execution for strategic relevance, originality, craft, brand alignment, and production quality.
* **Lead client conversations** 
 \- Present and defend creative ideas with confidence. Explain the reasoning behind recommendations and guide stakeholders through productive feedback cycles.
* **Develop creative talent** 
 \- Help creative professionals strengthen their judgment and craft through direct feedback, clear expectations, and thoughtful mentorship.
* **Use AI with intention** 
 \- Leverage AI tools to strengthen research, ideation, exploration, and workflow efficiency. Retain human ownership of strategy, accuracy, taste, sensitive decisions, and final approval.
* **Build a strong creative environment** 
 \- Encourage originality, curiosity, respectful challenge, accountability, and collaboration.



  





**What you will bring** 



* Around 8 years of relevant creative experience, including at least 3 years in creative leadership roles
* A portfolio demonstrating strong work across branding, visual communication, digital experiences, motion, or integrated campaigns, with clear examples of how you have leveraged AI in your creative process and outcomes
* Great attention to detail to catch any branding inconsistencies
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams toward original, strategically grounded creative work
* The ability to translate complex business challenges into clear creative strategies and compelling concepts
* A strong understanding of branding, storytelling, design, and audience\-centered communication with sound creative judgment and the ability to explain what is working, what needs to change, and why
* A business\-minded approach that connects creative decisions to audience and organizational goals with the ability to present ideas clearly, build stakeholder alignment, and guide feedback without losing the strategic intent
* Strong written and verbal English communication for nuanced client conversations, presentations, briefs, and feedback
* The adaptability, judgment, and reliability and strong internet connection needed to work effectively in a remote environment
* Practical experience using AI tools to strengthen creativity or efficiency without compromising quality or human accountability



  





**How we work** 




 Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection. You will work across client relationships, creative disciplines, and changing priorities.
 



  





 At least six hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is required so you can lead conversations, collaborate with teams, and make timely decisions.,
 



  





**What this role offers** 



* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W\-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast\-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.



  





**We believe great teams are built on shared values** 



* **Choose Positivity** 
 and lift those around you.
* **Say It Straight** 
 with honesty and respect.
* **Raise the Bar** 
 by never settling for average.
* **Take Ownership** 
 of your work and your impact.
* **Move with Purpose** 
 and make every action count.



  





**Success in this role means** 



* Creating work that is both strategically sound and creatively outstanding.
* Becoming a trusted creative partner to clients and internal teams.
* Elevating the quality of ideas, execution, and storytelling.
* Helping teams do their best work through clear feedback and mentorship.
* Balancing creativity with reliability, organization, and follow\-through.
* Embracing AI as a tool to enhance creativity and efficiency.



  





**Disclaimer:** 




 Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.
 



  





 Be cautious when applying. Official communications from Designity will come only from the Designity.com domain.
 



  





 At Designity, employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Us**
 Circle is building the world’s leading AI\-powered, all\-in\-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.
   

  

 We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30\+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.
   

  

 Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!
   

  

 Check out our
 **Careers** 
 page for more about working at Circle.
   

  

**About The Role**
**We’re excited to bring on Circle’s first Creative Director.**
 This is a unique opportunity to shape how Circle shows up in the world, and define the story of a generational company building the future of digital businesses.
   

  

 We’re looking for an exceptional creative storyteller who can help us develop strong, consistent narratives across everything Circle puts into the world: product launches, campaigns, ads, landing pages, announcements, partnerships, events, and more.
   

  

 You obsess over the power of a great narrative. You believe every word, visual, and detail matters. You have an exceptionally high creative bar, thrive in highly collaborative environments, and know how to influence people through the quality of the work itself.
   

  

 As Circle’s first Creative Director, you’ll first and foremost act as a creative extension of the founders. You will turn their ideas, product strategy, and company vision into narratives that are clear, memorable, and unmistakably Circle across all our assets.
   

  

 On a day\-to\-day basis, you’ll work closely with Circle’s founders and across our in\-house design studio, product marketing, paid media, video, and events teams to elevate our storytelling and creative execution across every major moment.
   

  

**Your goal is to help make Circle one of the most creatively distinct and definitive companies in the category of digital businesses.**
**What You'll Be Doing**
* Shape Circle’s narrative. Work closely with Circle’s founders to synthesize, sharpen, and evolve the story behind our long\-term vision, and translate it into clear, compelling narratives that can travel across everything we do.
* Own the creative direction of our biggest launches and campaigns. Find the angle, develop the brief, shape the story, and obsess over how we make each moment stand out. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing across launches, announcements, demos, and enablement to ensure everything feels cohesive, intentional, and unmistakably Circle. Doing this well requires developing a deep understanding of our product, customers, and market.
* Be a deeply embedded creative marketing partner to our design studio. You’ll work especially closely with our Design Studio, which is led by one of Circle’s co\-founders and won’t report to you. Success here involves shared taste, mutual trust, healthy creative tension, and the ability to move quickly together. You’ll occasionally lead external agencies as well — and when the moment calls for it, write the high\-stakes copy yourself: the headline, manifesto, launch script, or line someone delivers on stage.
* Raise the bar on our advertising and creative campaigns. Develop the concepts and narratives behind Circle’s ad creative, partnering up our Paid Acquisition team to turn them into high\-performing campaigns. They’ll bring the channel and media\-buying expertise; while you can make sure the creative is worth paying to distribute.
* Direct how our stories come to life across video and events. Get hands\-on with scripts, structure, pacing, and narrative for launch films, social, ads, virtual summits, and other major moments. You won’t be editing videos or producing events yourself, but you’ll understand the craft well enough to have strong opinions about what works in each medium, and collaborate deeply with the specialists who bring it to life.
* Influence the narrative behind brand experiences people remember across our webinars, virtual summits, conferences, and live events to align with company brand vision. This includes everything from the theme and programming to the booth, talks, slides, copy, and small details nobody else would think to obsess over.
* Turn partnerships into stories. Work with our Partnerships team to make more of our collaborations with creators and customers into stories we can distribute across our channels. You can help develop the concept, framing, name, narrative, and creative execution behind our biggest partnerships, and helping our partners tell those stories powerfully themselves.


**What We're Looking For**
* A body of work you’re genuinely proud of. We care far more about what you’ve made than the titles you’ve held or the number of years you’ve been doing it. You should be able to walk us through your best work piece by piece: the problem, the idea, the choices you made, what you personally contributed, and ultimately, whether it worked.
* Exceptional creative taste and judgment. You know great work when you see it, can articulate why it’s great, and have the conviction to push work until it gets there. Just as importantly, you know when an idea is trying too hard, when something is off\-brand, and when your own fingerprints are making the work worse rather than better.
* You’re an exceptional storyteller and writer. You can take something complicated and find the simple, compelling story inside it. You care deeply about language and will happily obsess over a headline, a launch narrative, or a single line of copy until it feels inevitable.
* A strong point of view, and the ability to make it better through collaboration. We don’t want someone who waits for a brief and executes it. We want someone who can tell us what the brief should be, challenge the premise when necessary, elevate ideas coming from the team and our founders, and make a compelling case for a different direction.
* Real fluency in video as a creative medium. You don’t need to shoot, edit, animate, or produce. But you should deeply understand what makes video work, from the script and opening seconds to structure, pacing, emotion, and payoff. You should also understand why a great launch film, social video, customer story, and paid ad require very different creative choices.
* Experience making creative that has to perform. You’ve developed ads and campaigns where the work was ultimately accountable to results. You’ve seen the numbers, learned from them, iterated because of them, and know how to partner with paid acquisition teams without allowing performance marketing to turn into boring marketing.
* An instinct for getting attention without going off script. You understand how to make a brand noticeable, surprising, and culturally relevant without chasing attention for its own sake. Ideally, you can show us a creative risk you fought for that worked, and another you talked the room out of because it wasn’t right for the brand.
* The ability to lead through influence, not hierarchy. There’s no large creative organization reporting to you. Much of your impact will come from getting exceptional work out of designers, marketers, writers, video producers, agencies, and founders who don’t report to you. You know how to raise the creative bar without becoming a bottleneck.
* A great eye for design and deep respect for the craft. You don’t need to be a designer, but you should be able to work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with exceptional ones. Our Design Studio is led by a co\-founder and operates with a very high bar; you’ll need the visual taste, vocabulary, and collaborative instincts to be a trusted creative partner to that team.
* Experience working closely with founders. You’re comfortable working with founders who care deeply about the product, brand, and details. You will need to extract the vision, challenge it when needed, and turn it into something better than either of you would have arrived at independently.
* An obsession with understanding what how to tell the world about we do and why it matters. The best creative work here will come from understanding Circle at a deep level: our product, customers, competitors, category, and where the market is going. You should genuinely enjoy developing that level of context rather than treating it as somebody else’s job.
* Exceptional communication skills. Circle is global, remote, and highly asynchronous. You’ll need outstanding written and verbal English (CEFR C2 or equivalent), and the ability to make your thinking clear enough that great work can move forward even when everyone isn’t in the same room.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
 Circle offers U.S.\-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.

title: AI focused Creative Director
description:
**ABOUT US** 




  





 Eostier is a brand group building consumer brands with fully in\-house teams, operating at a $20M\+ annual run rate. This role sits on our new health\-focused supplement brand.
 



 The forecast: mid 8 figures with nine figures within reach. This is one of the first dedicated creative hires on the team that will grow with us.
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




  





 We're looking for an AI focused Creative Director to own the visual side of every ad we run. Not execution, ideation. You're the person who decides what an ad actually shows: the 3D and 2D animation, the b\-roll, the clip concepts, and you make sure it never looks like the last one.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on, ideas\-first role. B\-roll is yours end to end: you come up with what to show and generate it yourself, then hand editors a finished clip to drop into the ad. You already know claymation, Pixar\-style, song ads, and whatever else is working right now, cold, or this isn't for you.
 



  





 For those specialty formats, you write the SOP so editors can execute them without you in the room. Everything else, you're hands\-on: generating the b\-roll visuals and reviewing the 3 editors' work before anything ships.
 



  





**The workflow:**
 a scriptwriter writes the ad. You come up with what the ad should show and how. For specialty formats you make the SOP so the editors can execute it properly.
 



  





 You don't generate the full ad yourself, and you're not the one planning which overall format we run next, though if you see something working, you can absolutely recommend it, you’ll be in charge of the visuals and ideation behind those.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* Ideate \& create the visuals for ads: the b\-roll, 3D/2D animation, and clips that bring each script to life
* Diversifying the visuals as much as possible: a 3D model explanation, a 2D model explanation,
 **a close up** 
 animation from inside the vessel, a
 **non close up** 
 animation inside the vessel and
 
 more diversity especially on the mechanism explanation
 
 during the ad
* Make sure every visual is accurate to the script.
* Write SOPs for executing specific formats so the video editors can run with your concepts without you in the room
* Manage and review the video editors' work before anything ships. You're the last check that an ad is actually good to go
* Stay ahead of trends: burner accounts on social and the Facebook Ads Library, both for new formats and for how other brands execute and diversify their own visuals
* Test new AI models and workflows regularly so output stays realistic and the outputs gets faster over time



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* Deep, current knowledge of e\-commerce ad formats: claymation, Pixar\-style, song ads, and whatever's trending right now.
* Passionate about AI content, new models and creation
* Familiar with different formats (claymation, Pixar\-style, song ads...)
* Strong visual ideation, not just execution. You come up with what to show, not just how to render it
* Comfortable managing and giving direct feedback to a small team of editors
* Obsessive about accuracy: visuals need to match the script, not just look good on their own
* Bonus if you're already using AI tools and workflows to move faster and automate parts of the process
* Comfortable with speed, ambiguity, and autonomy in a fully remote setup
* Preferable to have supplement brand experience



  





**What's In It For You** 




  




* Real ownership of the visual direction for a brand going from zero to multi\-eight\-figures in year one
* Direct access to the founder early on, then increasing autonomy as the process runs itself with you
* Small, fast\-moving team. No layers, no waiting on approvals that don't matter



  





**How to Apply** 




  





 We only review applications submitted through the form attached. It takes less than 5 minutes.
 



  





***Any beginner portfolio will not be considered, this is a position for someone who is familiar with everything said above, if unfamiliar with those, you will not be shortlisted.***
