description:
**Company Description**

**About Entain**

There's nothing like a career at Entain. We're a leading, global sports betting and gaming company and we're upping the excitement and increasing player safety. We're a FTSE company with iconic brands including Ladbrokes, Coral, BetMGM, Eurobet and bwin, and we have an energy that drives us to perform at the height of our potential. Whether you're an engineer, marketer or retail specialist, a career here is a complete game changer.


**Job Description**

This is a **hybrid** role. As a **Marketing Administration Executive** , you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth day\-to\-day running of marketing operations across France, Spain and Portugal. Acting as the backbone of the regional marketing team, you will coordinate key administrative processes, manage budgets and supplier payments, support compliance requirements, and help ensure marketing activity is delivered efficiently and in line with internal processes.


Reporting to the **Head of Southwestern Europe** , you will be part of the **Southwestern Europe Marketing Team** , who are responsible for developing and delivering local marketing strategies and campaigns across France, Spain and Portugal. The team works closely with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders to drive growth, strengthen brand presence and deliver impactful customer experiences across multiple markets. This role plays a vital part in supporting the operational effectiveness of the team and ensuring marketing activity can be executed seamlessly.


This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast\-paced international marketing team, where you'll gain exposure to a broad range of marketing activities and collaborate with colleagues across multiple functions and markets. You'll have the chance to make a tangible impact by improving processes, supporting key stakeholders, and helping the team operate effectively. If you're highly organised, detail\-oriented and enjoy being at the centre of a busy, collaborative environment, **could this be the perfect next step for you?**

You Will:


* Coordinate the creation, tracking and renewal of marketing contracts, ensuring the correct approval processes are followed and records are maintained accurately.
* Raise and track purchase orders across France, Spain and Portugal, ensuring spend aligns with approved budgets and supplier requirements.
* Process and monitor marketing invoices, working closely with suppliers, Finance and internal stakeholders to resolve queries and support timely payments.
* Maintain budget trackers, reconciliations and reporting updates, providing marketing teams with accurate visibility of committed and actual spend.
* Support procurement and supplier onboarding activities by coordinating required information, following up approvals and keeping stakeholders informed.
* Coordinate marketing\-related compliance information requirements across France, Spain and Portugal, ensuring information is collected, organised and submitted on time.
* Organise and maintain marketing files, records and trackers, ensuring information is accurate, accessible and up to date.
* Provide day\-to\-day operational support to the regional marketing team, including meeting coordination, supplier follow\-up, document preparation and process management.
* Build strong working relationships with Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Compliance and external partners to ensure smooth and efficient delivery of marketing operations.

**Qualifications**

You Have:


* Works carefully and accurately, checking details before sharing information or moving a process forward.
* Plans work clearly, keeps trackers up to date and follows through on agreed actions.
* Collaborates well with colleagues across different markets and functions, adapting communication to the person and situation.
* Asks questions early when something is unclear and follows the right approval routes.
* Responds calmly to changing priorities and helps others understand what is needed to keep work moving.
* Looks for simple improvements that make recurring administration easier, clearer and more consistent.

**Additional Information**

**Benefits**

At Entain, we know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire you. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:


* A regular bonus and great pension.
* €9\.60 food vouchers per day.
* 25 days annual leave
* Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.
* Private healthcare and wellbeing support.
* A stake in our success through our ShareSave scheme.

We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves.

title: Senior Director & General Manager, Iberia
description:
**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.


Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.


**Job Summary:**


The Senior Director \& General Manager for Iberia (Spain \& Portugal) is responsible for driving sales growth and delivering revenue and transaction margin targets across the full PayPal portfolio within the Iberian market. This senior leadership role requires a strategic, commercially oriented executive with a strong track record of building and scaling high performing teams, developing market specific growth strategies, and cultivating strong internal and external partnerships.
  

  

Reporting to the SVP Europe, the Senior Director \& GM for Iberia acts as the in market leader representing PayPal across all core segments—Large Enterprise, SMB, and Consumer—while orchestrating cross functional alignment to accelerate growth end\-to\-end.
**Job Description:**


**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Oversee operations across multiple functions within the division, business unit, country, region, or banking entity

Establish budgets and set short* \-and long\-range objectives for the division/business unit/country/region
* Develop criteria for monitoring progress and measuring success against financial and operational goals
* Direct the organization to ensure the attainment of financial and operational goals in support of the company's overall strategic objectives
* Develop and implement plans to advance the company's products and services to meet market demands
* Collaborate with senior management to align financial plans and strategic initiatives
* Monitor market trends and competitive landscape to inform strategic decision\-making
* Provide leadership and guidance to functional managers and teams to drive performance and achieve objectives
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies

**Minimum Qualifications:**


* 12\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:**


This role will lead Iberia’s vertical leaders across sales, relationship management, account management, and inside sales, working closely with risk, operations, product development, marketing, engineering, global entity management, finance, HR, and legal to ensure the market operates with excellence, compliance, and a clear growth vision.
**Key Responsibilities**


*Sales Strategy \& Market Execution*
* Develop and implement a comprehensive sales strategy to deliver revenue and Transaction Margin goals across Spain and Portugal.
* Drive growth across Enterprise, SMB, and Consumer segments, ensuring alignment between market needs and PayPal’s product and service portfolio.
* Identify, prioritize, and accelerate opportunities in key verticals relevant to the Iberian market (e.g., retail, travel, digital services, marketplaces).
* Own the full sales cycle—from pipeline creation to contract negotiation and closing.

*Team Leadership \& Talent Development*
* Lead, mentor, and inspire a high\-performing commercial organization across Spain and Portugal.
* Set clear objectives, KPIs, and operating rhythms, ensuring accountability and a performance\-driven culture.
* Build a collaborative, diverse, and innovative environment focused on continuous improvement.

*Strategic Relationship Management*
* Establish and maintain senior\-level relationships with strategic merchants, partners, regulators, industry associations, and key stakeholders across Iberia.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, deeply understanding their businesses and positioning PayPal’s value proposition effectively.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver seamless customer experiences and drive long\-term adoption.

*Market Intelligence, Insights \& Reporting*
* Monitor competitive activity, industry evolution, and macroeconomic developments across Spain and Portugal.
* Leverage market insights, data analytics, and customer feedback to refine strategies and unlock new growth opportunities.
* Provide regular business reviews, accurate forecasts, and strategic recommendations to Southern Europe leadership.

*Cross\-functional Leadership \& Enterprise Alignment*
* Partner with Marketing to design targeted campaigns and brand‑building activities specific to the Iberian market.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering to align Iberian customer needs with PayPal’s product roadmap.
* Ensure strong collaboration with Customer Success, Risk, Operations, and Compliance to maintain high satisfaction, operational efficiency, and regulatory alignment.

**Job Qualifications**


* 15\+ years of commercial/sales leadership experience in technology, payments, financial services, or digital industries.
* Strong understanding of digital payments, fintech, emerging technologies, and market trends relevant to Spain and Portugal.

title: Principal Country HR Partner - Fixed Term
description:
### **Strength in Trust**



OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down—it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

### **Strength in Trust**



OneTrust's mission is to enable organizations to use data and AI responsibly. Our platform simplifies collecting data with consent and preferences, automates data governance with integrated risk management across privacy, security, IT/tech, third\-party, and AI risk, and enables responsible data use by applying and enforcing data policies across the entire data estate and lifecycle. Recognized as a market pioneer and leader, OneTrust serves more than 14,000 customers globally.


### **The Challenge**



We are seeking a strategic, commercially minded Senior Principal / Director, HR Country Manager to serve as the HR leader for our Madrid office, our hub for the EMEA region. This role will be based in Madrid and will provide visible, on\-site leadership for the site while partnering closely with local leaders and global People stakeholders on both day\-to\-day operations and broader business strategy. The role combines executive partnership, strong operational and compliance oversight, and hands\-on support for complex people matters in Spain. This leader will also spend part of their time mentoring the current senior HR country leader to help strengthen their capability and develop toward a broader site leadership scope.


### **Your Mission**



To translate business strategy into a Spain people strategy that enables growth, leadership effectiveness, organizational health, compliance, and employee experience for the Madrid site and broader Spain employee population. This leader will ensure that OneTrust's global People philosophy is applied thoughtfully in Spain while advising leaders on local market realities, regulatory risk, workforce planning, and high\-impact people decisions.


### **You Are**



A seasoned HR leader with strong business acumen, sound judgment, and credibility with senior stakeholders. You bring deep expertise in Spanish employment law and labor practices, a track record of leading through complexity and change, and the ability to balance strategic influence with hands\-on execution. You are pragmatic, data\-driven, and comfortable operating as both a site\-level operator and a strategic business partner in a fast\-moving, multinational environment.


### **Main Tasks \& Responsibilities**


* Serve as the senior in\-person HR leader for Spain and the effective HR Manager for the Madrid site, acting as the primary advisor to local leaders on organizational strategy, people risk, workforce effectiveness, and leadership decision\-making.
* Partner with business leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, succession planning, talent strategy, retention priorities, and organizational change aligned to business goals.
* Translate global People strategies into Spain market execution that is legally compliant, culturally relevant, and operationally scalable, while ensuring strong partnership across People Business Partnership, People Operations, Payroll, HRIS, Total Rewards, Finance, and Legal.
* Lead complex employee relations, investigations, disciplinary matters, grievances, restructures, and sensitive exits in Spain, including representing the company at SMAC conciliation proceedings where required and guiding leaders through legally informed decision\-making.
* Own Spain labor and statutory compliance across the employee lifecycle, including employment documentation, policy localization, working time and leave practices, separation requirements and execution, audit readiness, and compliance initiatives such as the establishment and ongoing governance of the Equality Plan for the Spanish entity.
* Identify and recommend policy, process, and controls updates to mitigate risk and maintain audit readiness.
* Provide strategic HR leadership for organizational changes, manager capability, team health, and culture, ensuring leaders are equipped to make fair, consistent, and business\-aligned people decisions.
* Use HR metrics and workforce analytics to identify trends, assess organizational health and compliance risk, and recommend actions to improve employee experience, manager effectiveness, and operational performance.
* Mentor the current HR country partner and local team to help broaden their capability and support their development toward stronger site leadership and support remits.

### **Minimum Education and Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree in HR, business, or a related field preferred.
* Deep knowledge of Spain employment law, labor practices, statutory compliance, and employee relations frameworks, including experience with sensitive exits, conciliation processes, and practical application of local requirements in a business setting.
* Direct experience leading Equality Plan design, implementation, governance, and related compliance initiatives within Spain, inclusive of a strong track record representing company interests with employee representative bodies.
* Strong experience with HRIS platforms and reporting tools; Workday strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical capability and comfort using data to influence executive decisions and improve HR effectiveness; professional HR certification is a plus.
* Fluency in Spanish and English required.

### **Background \& Experience**


* 12\+ years of progressive HR experience, including meaningful experience in senior HR leadership, HRBP, country HR, or director\-level roles.
* Experience as the leading HR partner for one or more offices is required.
* Proven experience leading complex employee relations, investigations, restructures, sensitive exits, and legally informed decision\-making.
* Strong track record of operating in Spain's regulatory environment and applying local requirements within a global or multinational company context.
* Experience leading or influencing cross\-functional teams and driving execution through ambiguity, scale, and change.
* Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, and the ability to balance strategic leadership with operational rigor.

### **Where we Work**



We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.



Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.


### **Benefits**



As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.


### **Resources**

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:


* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

### **Your Data**



You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview**.** You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

  



Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.


### **Our Commitment to You**



When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact \- driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high\-performance, player\-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. Together, we’re not just shaping brighter smiles, we’re unlocking the potential of people everywhere, including our own.

**Introduction:**


As Senior Director, Deputy Chief Information Security Officer, you will be the operational partner to the Chief Information Security Officer and act on their behalf during periods of delegated absence.


This role has a clear focus: strengthening application and product security across digital products, platforms and connected medical devices, while supporting the execution of Straumann Group’s wider cybersecurity strategy.

**Your Role:**

* You will lead and mature the application and product security function, embedding secure software development practices across architecture, design, development, testing, release and post\-market activities.
* You will define and govern secure software development lifecycle requirements, security architecture reviews, threat modelling, application security testing, vulnerability remediation, software supply\-chain security, SBOMs and third\-party component governance.
* You will oversee product vulnerability management, coordinated vulnerability disclosure and post\-market cybersecurity monitoring, ensuring product\-security requirements become practical engineering controls.
* Working closely with Product Development, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Trust \& Assurance, Security Operations, Legal, Privacy and strategic technology partners, you will help ensure security risks, exceptions and remediation decisions are clearly documented and well governed.
* You will also support the CISO in translating cybersecurity strategy into measurable execution, lead selected cross\-functional security priorities, resolve issues across product and technology teams, and represent the CISO in internal or external forums when delegated.

**Your Profile:**

* You bring significant leadership experience in cybersecurity, application security, product security or software security.
* You have built or led application and product security capabilities in a complex enterprise environment.
* You understand secure software development, DevSecOps, modern application architectures, cloud\-native applications, APIs, identity, CI/CD pipelines and software supply\-chain security.
* You have experience with threat modelling, security architecture, penetration testing and vulnerability management.
* You are confident engaging senior stakeholders, auditors and regulators, and can translate cybersecurity and regulatory requirements into practical, risk\-based controls.
* Experience in regulated environments is important; medical devices, healthcare, life sciences or manufacturing experience would be an advantage.
* Knowledge of medical\-device cybersecurity and secure product lifecycle requirements is strongly preferred.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CSSLP, CCSP or equivalent are welcome, but not mandatory.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* You combine technical credibility with senior leadership judgement. You can challenge constructively, influence across organisational boundaries and focus teams on material product and software\-security risks.
* You are effective at turning complex security and regulatory topics into clear decisions, practical actions and measurable outcomes.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Please note: This job is advertised for Luxembourg but can be located in any of our EU sites or offices.  

  

We are seeking a Senior Analyst to own the analytical backbone across multiple high\-impact domains within EU Inbound Supply Chain. This is not a single\-metric reporting role you will design scalable data architectures, build production\-grade analytics systems, and drive strategic decisions through data, working across both real\-time streaming and batch processing to get the team the right data at the right time.  

  

The ideal candidate pairs deep technical expertise in data engineering and analytics with the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and turn ambiguous business problems into measurable solutions. You're equally comfortable building scalable pipelines on AWS services over terabytes of data, architecting a real\-time monitoring solution, presenting to senior leadership, or prototyping GenAI tools to scale analytical capacity.  

  

What makes this role unique:  

\- Context\-switching is the job \- one week you're decomposing a delivery\-accuracy variance across the EU network; the next you're building a real\-time Inbound Management pipeline; the week after you're prototyping a GenAI tool that auto\-generates root\-cause narratives for business reviews.  

\- Federated stakeholder model \- you'll work across Engineering, Science, Transportation, Planning, Finance, and Operations. Aligning on definitions and building shared analytical frameworks matters as much as writing the code.  

\- GenAI as a force multiplier \- you won't just use AI tools, you'll build them: agentic deep\-dives, automated narrative generation, and intelligent alerting that scale analysis across inbound speed, DEA, and transportation optimization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and own end\-to\-end data architectures spanning real\-time streaming (Kinesis, Flink) and batch processing (EMR, Redshift, Athena), selecting the right paradigm for the latency, volume, and criticality at hand.
* Build production\-grade, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines processing multi\-TB datasets daily across Redshift, Athena, S3, and DynamoDB with data\-quality checks, monitoring, and alerting.
* Architect real\-time analytics for operational monitoring: live visibility into inbound flows, delivery accuracy, dock congestion, and network disruptions.
* Own metric frameworks and reporting: design KPIs, build automated dashboards (QuickSight), support WBR/MBR narratives, and own the “why” through root\-cause analysis when metrics move.
* Develop GenAI\-driven tooling and agentic workflows that automate reporting narratives and root\-cause analysis, reducing time\-to\-insight from days to minutes.
* Drive deep\-dive investigations across complex, multi\-source datasets tracing issues to specific products, warehouses, or routes, then quantifying network\-wide impact with statistical methods.

  

A day in the life  

You'll have exposure to the full data\-product lifecycle — from defining metrics to designing architectures, building pipelines, and delivering insights to senior leadership. A typical week might include:  

* Designing pipelines that unify real\-time event streams (shipment scans, trailer movements, inventory updates) and batch sources (forecasts, historical performance) into a single analytical layer.
* Writing advanced SQL across multiple sources to investigate why delivery promises were missed from the customer order through placement, transportation, and fulfillment.
* Building Python\-based automation for anomaly detection, statistical modeling, and reporting.
* Iterating on GenAI\-powered tools and presenting data\-driven recommendations, with clear quantification of customer and cost impact, to senior leadership.
* Triaging emerging operational issues from real\-time dashboards and providing data\-backed context.

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, computer science, economics, engineering, or operations research.
* Experience in analytics, data engineering, or business intelligence at a large\-scale enterprise, including data\-warehouse architecture, data modeling, and ETL/ELT pipeline design.
* Advanced SQL and programming (Python or equivalent) to extract, transform, and clean large (multi\-TB) datasets, plus scripting for pipeline automation and scheduling.
* Experience with both real\-time streaming (e.g., Kinesis, Kafka, Flink) and batch processing (e.g., EMR, Hive) systems, and with data\-visualization tools (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar).
* Experience translating operational problems into analytical solutions and communicating results to senior leadership (Director/VP) with clear business\-impact quantification.

The Senior Protection Assistant normally reports to a more senior Protection colleague. The Senior Protection Assistant provides quality, timely and effective protection support to persons of concern (PoC) and identifies opportunities to mainstream protection methodologies and safeguards in operational responses. S/he contributes to designing a comprehensive protection strategy and may liaise externally with local authorities and partners on protection issues as guided by the supervisor.

* Consistently apply International and National Law and applicable UN/UNHCR and IASC policy, standards and codes of conduct.

Creative Fabrica is a subscription platform serving millions of creators, designers, and crafters worldwide. We're built on the principle that everyone can be creative. We remove what stands in the way: expensive software, technical expertise, and time\-consuming production.



Our Studio AI suite offers more than 26 specialized AI tools that automate technical work: generate custom images, remove backgrounds, create fonts, and produce publication\-ready designs in minutes instead of hours.



Our content library contains 15\+ million commercially\-licensed fonts, graphics, SVGs, and templates, giving you professional\-quality building blocks without the expense or time of creating assets from scratch.

**About the role:**



Creative Fabrica Studio is where people turn ideas into real creative work.



It's our AI\-native creative suite, image, video, audio, 3D, and a full design workspace, built so anyone can go from a rough idea to a professional asset in minutes. Generators, editors, and tools live in one product: studio.creativefabrica.com. Thousands of makers use Creative Fabrica; Studio is how we turn that audience into creators who ship work every day.



We're not polishing a finished product. We're redesigning Studio into an experience that matches how ambitious the tech already is: faster, clearer, more distinctive, and genuinely easy to use, the kind of product designers wish they got to shape from the ground up.



We are looking for a Product Designer who brings strong visual craft, a focus on user experience, and well structured Figma files that developers can build from smoothly.



As a Product Designer, you'll take ownership of the end\-to\-end design for Creative Fabrica Studio and raise the bar for usability and visual quality across the platform. You will work closely with developers and product as a hands\-on partner: independent enough to drive the design direction, collaborative enough to turn ideas into buildable UI quickly.



This is not a role for endless exploration or for lightly adapting patterns from elsewhere. We want someone who brings original product taste, ships thoughtfully and often, and uses AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar. You will have real ownership. * Lead the redesign of Studio end\-to\-end: information architecture, flows, UI, and interaction details that make the product easier and more delightful to use.

* Turn product goals and constraints into concrete screens, components, and prototypes that developers can implement with confidence.
* Partner daily with engineers: clarify intent, resolve edge cases early, and keep design and build in sync.
* Produce structured Figma work, clear hierarchy, components, variants, states, and specs, so handoff is efficient and unambiguous.
* Design for real creator workflows: reduce friction, improve discoverability, and make advanced AI capabilities feel simple.
* Move from concept to usable design quickly; prefer strong iterations over polishing one direction for days.

* Build and evolve a coherent design system / UI language for Studio that scales across new features.
* Validate designs with lightweight methods (critiques, quick tests, usage feedback) and adjust without derailing delivery.
* Balance originality with clarity: distinctive where it matters, familiar where it helps users move fast.
* Stay current with product design, AI product UX, Figma workflows, and emerging patterns in generative\-media tools.


**What you will need:**


* 5\+ years designing digital products (UI/UX or product design), with a portfolio that shows shipped product work.
* Excellent UI craft: typography, layout, visual hierarchy, interaction design, and polish in complex product surfaces.
* Advanced Figma skills for developer handoff (components, variants, auto\-layout, clear states and specs).
* Proven ability to redesign or substantially improve a product experience with measurable usability gains.
* Proven ability to take a product or major surface from concept to polished, buildable UI quickly.
* Comfortable using AI tools in the design workflow; strong written and spoken English.
* Thrives in high\-pace environments: manages shifting priorities, ships on deadline, and stays decisive when briefs or constraints change.
* Independent and ownership driven: proposes direction, unblocks yourself, and partners with developers without heavy process.
* Original and tasteful: brings creative point of view; does not default to copy\-paste industry patterns.


**Nice to have:**


* Agency background delivering digital product, web, or app redesigns for real clients under commercial pressure.

To check their schedules. Track their hours. Manage their teams.

The adventure started in 2016 with a simple idea: making HR easier for businesses and the people who run them.


Today, thousands of companies across Europe rely on Combo to simplify their day\-to\-day HR operations.


Our platform brings together the tools teams need every day: scheduling, contract management, payroll preparation, team communication, and productivity tracking.


And we're still growing.

**Your role**
-------------


You'll be the main point of contact and advocate for our Spanish customers.


Your mission is simple: help them get the most out of Combo while building a Customer Success approach that can scale with our business.


The role combines **Account Management, Customer Success, Customer Care, and continuous improvement**.

### **You'll support our customers every day**


You'll build strong and trusted relationships with our key accounts and help them get the most value from Combo.


You'll also handle more operational requests from customers with speed, empathy, and pragmatism.


You'll become a key point of contact for our Spanish customers and make sure every interaction with Combo leads to a clear and useful outcome.

### **You'll build processes that can scale**


Not every customer needs the same level of support.


For our key accounts, you'll provide a more personalised and proactive approach.


For the rest of our customer base, you'll design and implement scalable ways to provide value: webinars, communication campaigns, automated sequences, content, Help Center articles, and more.


The goal? Deliver the right level of support at the right time, without relying exclusively on manual interactions.


You'll identify friction points throughout the customer journey and find practical ways to simplify and automate recurring interactions.

### **You'll keep a close eye on customer health**


You'll maintain a clear understanding of your customer base.


Product usage, engagement, satisfaction, churn risks: you'll know where to look and how to interpret the signals.


You'll identify potential risks early and implement concrete action plans to prevent churn.


Data quality is essential in this role. Your CRM will be reliable, your customer information up to date, and your tracking rigorous enough to give the wider team a clear view of what's happening.

### **You'll bring the voice of the Spanish market to Combo**


You'll be close to our Spanish customers.


Their feedback, frustrations, and needs will be valuable insights for the rest of Combo.


You'll structure this feedback and turn it into clear, actionable insights for our Product and Operations teams.


Your role won't simply be to forward customer requests.


You'll help us understand what's really happening on the ground and what our Spanish customers need.

You have at least **2 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Customer Support**, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.


You've already worked with customers requiring different levels of support and are comfortable combining **High Touch and scalable, Low Touch approaches**.


You're a natural problem solver.

You don't need every process to already exist before moving forward. You're comfortable structuring, testing, and building things.


You're autonomous, organised, and comfortable in a fast\-paced environment.

You're also comfortable with numbers and able to understand topics related to HR or payroll.


And most importantly:


**You're a native or fully fluent Spanish speaker**, both written and spoken.


**You're fluent in English**, as you'll work daily with your manager and international teams.


French is a strong plus, but not a requirement.

**Why join Combo?**
-------------------


Because you won't be joining a Customer Success organisation where everything has already been figured out.


You'll have a customer base to support, but also plenty of things to build.


You'll have a real impact on how we support our Spanish customers: improving processes, structuring data, creating playbooks, and testing new approaches.


You'll work closely with our Spanish Sales team while also being part of an international Customer Success organisation.


This is a role for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives in fast\-moving environments, and gets just as much satisfaction from solving a customer problem as from building a process that prevents it from happening again.

title: Video Editor / Motion Designer
description:

 specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses facing sales growth challenges.  At
 **CapsLock** 
 , we value people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and strong relationships. Our diverse, global team speaks over 10 languages whose ideas inspire the innovation that runs through everything we do, from unique technology to industry\-leading services and customer experiences.
   

  

**﻿Role Overview**
 The Video Editor / Motion Designer at CapsLock creates and edits high\-performing video content with the primary goal of improving conversion rates. This role sits at the intersection of creative storytelling, motion design, and modern AI tooling — producing advertising videos that convert cold traffic across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and landing pages.
   

  

 You'll work closely with the Creative Director, marketers, and copywriters to develop, test, and iterate on video concepts, using AI tools alongside traditional post\-production to accelerate output and raise the quality bar.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**﻿**
**Video Creation \& Production**
* Develop video ads from concept to final delivery — funnel formats, YouTube, Facebook, and TikTok
* Edit and enhance videos using dialogue, graphics, music, sound design, and visual effects, ensuring logical sequencing and strong storytelling
* Create AI\-generated advertising creative for paid social and landing pages, converting cold traffic into warm leads
* Produce and refine photorealistic human characters in video, with attention to realism in motion, expression, and speech synchronisation
* Enhance video quality through upscaling, smoothness improvements, and post\-processing
* Deliver polished final cuts optimised for advertising performance goals


**Concept Development \& Pre\-Production**
* Craft clear storylines and narrative structures tailored to platform and audience
* Prepare shoot guides and gather reference materials when collaborating with videographers
* Research and propose multiple creative angles, selecting the best options based on data and research
* Test different formats, calls\-to\-action, and visual approaches


**AI Tools \& Optimization**
* Research, test, and integrate new AI tools into the production workflow to improve efficiency and output quality
* Experiment with AI\-assisted editing techniques including avatar generation, voice synthesis, and automated post\-production
* Use AI tools to reduce production time without compromising quality


**Analytics \& Performance**
* Analyse video performance metrics and use insights to optimise creative
* Run A/B tests on formats, hooks, CTAs, and creative elements — monitor and document results promptly
* Build deep product knowledge and apply it to data\-driven creative decisions


**Collaboration \& Trend Integration**
* Work closely with the Creative Director, copywriters, marketers, and designers to ensure creative alignment
* Track and apply the latest video trends, viral formats, and platform\-specific features
* Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards


 Requirements:
   

  

**Must\-Have Skills**
* Full post\-production capability: cutting, titling, colour correction, After Effects, sound mixing
* Strong command of video rhythm, pacing, transitions, typography, and sound design
* Skills in improving video quality — sharpness, smoothness, upscaling
* Hands\-on experience creating AI\-generated video from scratch or from references
* Ability to produce realistic human characters in video, including lip\-sync and speech\-to\-movement synchronisation
* Deep enough understanding of video editing to speak the language and spot problems early
* Ability to work from a detailed brief and proactively propose creative solutions
* Comfort collaborating with a Creative Director on iterations and new concepts


**Technical Skills**
* 2\+ years of experience in video editing, post\-production, or motion design as a primary discipline
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. Desktop\-based editing is required — portfolios built on mobile\-only tools such as CapCut will not be considered
* Experience working within an agency or structured in\-house team, with established workflows and reporting lines
* Working experience with AI video tools: Veo, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, HeyGen, or similar
* Experience with AI image generation tools: Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar
* Solid understanding of video formats for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook
* Comfortable reviewing performance analytics and iterating based on data
* Upper\-intermediate English (B2\) or higher


**﻿Soft Skills**
* Curious to explore new tools, formats, and creative approaches
* Adaptable to shifting priorities and fast\-paced team dynamics
* High execution speed without compromising quality
* Consistent on\-time delivery and strong attention to deadlines
* Strong attention to detail, especially around compliance and brand guidelines
* Critical thinking and a problem\-solving mindset
* Clear, professional communication and team collaboration skills
* Initiative to find solutions even when processes are undefined


**Why do we deserve your attention?**

**Remote Work**
 We are a truly remote\-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
**About Us**


We are an award\-winning California\-based environmental consulting firm with 600\+ professionals and more than 30 years of diverse experience serving clients in transportation, energy, water, infrastructure, private development, and government sectors. Our mission is to deliver practical, science\-based environmental and planning solutions that support communities, infrastructure, and natural systems.


As a people\-centric organization, we value collaboration, fairness, and transparency, and are committed to fostering a workplace that supports both personal and professional growth while offering robust career opportunities. We are especially proud of our recent Great Place To Work® certification, which reflects an independent assessment of our culture and our team member experiences.

**About The Role**


Rincon Consultants, Inc. is seeking a **Facilities Manager** to provide strategic oversight and day\-to\-day management of our leased office locations. This role is responsible for ensuring Rincon’s workplaces support operational effectiveness, team member experience, client\-facing professionalism, and consistency across our offices.


The Facilities Manager will lead real estate planning, site selection, lease negotiations and renewals, workplace standards, facilities operations, vendor management, capital improvements, and space planning. This position will play an important role in ensuring Rincon’s physical footprint aligns with our growth strategy, geographic expansion, and long\-term operational needs.


Reporting to the Director, People Services, this role will partner closely with Accounting, Legal, Operations, IT, Office Managers, and company leadership to deliver safe, efficient, professional, and well\-managed workplace environments.

**How We Collaborate**


This role may offer a hybrid work setup, blending time in the office with remote work as business needs evolve. We enjoy coming together in person to collaborate, connect with teammates, and partner across the organization.


Because this position oversees Rincon’s physical office environments and supports facilities needs across multiple locations, regular in\-person presence and travel between Rincon offices may be required based on business and project needs. Preferred locations: **Ventura, Santa Barbara, SLO, San Diego, and Sacramento.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the strategic oversight and day\-to\-day management of Rincon’s leased office locations.
* Partner with the Director, People Services and executive leadership to assess geographic expansion needs and evaluate opportunities for new offices, relocations, or consolidations.
* Identify and evaluate potential office locations based on operational, financial, accessibility, and brand considerations.
* Conduct due diligence and develop business cases and recommendations for prospective office locations and real estate decisions.
* Lead lease negotiations and renewals in partnership with Finance and Legal, ensuring terms align with Rincon’s long\-term operational strategy.
* Manage landlord and property management relationships, monitor lease requirements, and proactively manage renewal timelines.
* Establish and maintain workplace standards that reflect Rincon’s brand, professionalism, and culture across office layouts, furnishings, signage, and client\-facing spaces.
* Oversee office build\-outs, renovations, capital improvements, and space planning.
* Manage facilities vendors supporting maintenance, cleaning, security, utilities, and other building services.
* Establish and oversee preventative maintenance programs and address facilities issues promptly to minimize operational disruption.
* Develop and manage facilities budgets, monitor operating expenses, and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Partner with Finance on long\-term capital planning and real estate forecasting
* Coordinate building compliance with applicable safety requirements and partner with Safety leadership to support workplace safety standards.
* Support emergency preparedness and business continuity planning across Rincon locations.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 8\+ years of progressive experience in facilities management, corporate real estate, corporate services, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience negotiating leases, managing renewals, and maintaining productive landlord and property management relationships.
* Strong vendor management experience across facilities, maintenance, building services, or related functions.
* Experience developing and managing facilities budgets, operating expenses, and cost controls.
* Strong project management skills with experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, priorities, vendors, and timelines.
* Ability to develop thoughtful recommendations and business cases related to office locations, real estate decisions, and capital investments.
* Strong stakeholder partnership skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Finance, Legal, Operations, IT, People Services, and organizational leadership.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands\-on oversight of day\-to\-day facilities operations.
* Strong communication, organization, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience supporting facilities or corporate real estate operations across multiple office locations.
* Experience with office site selection, relocations, consolidations, and new office openings.
* Experience overseeing workplace design, office build\-outs, renovations, and capital improvement projects.
* Experience developing workplace standards across multiple locations or offices
* Experience with long\-term capital planning and real estate forecasting
* Experience supporting workplace safety, emergency preparedness, and business continuity initiatives.
* Experience working within a professional services, consulting, or similarly distributed organization.

**Investing in You**


The base salary range for this full\-time position is $110,000\.00\-$135,000\.00 plus a generous benefits program. Salary ranges are based on the market median of similar jobs, according to third\-party salary benchmark surveys. Base pay is determined based on internal equity and a candidate’s job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.


We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards Package designed to support employee well\-being, growth, and financial security. Our benefits are designed to offer flexibility and choice, including health coverage options, employer\-sponsored insurance, retirement benefits, generous time off, and programs that support learning, growth, and community engagement.


Explore more about our culture, benefits, and life at Rincon on our Culture and Benefits page.

**Additional Employment Information**


Individuals offered employment must successfully complete a pre\-employment drug screening as a condition of employment. Additionally, those hired who may be assigned to federal projects will be subject to further drug testing, including screening for cannabinoids (THC/marijuana), in compliance with the Drug\-Free Workplace Act of 1988 and other applicable federal regulations, which take precedence over California state and local laws.




Rincon Consultants does not accept unsolicited applicant/candidate resumes from search firm recruiters and/or temporary agencies that do not have a signed contract and specified work order with Rincon Consultants. Further, such resumes received will be deemed the sole property of Rincon Consultants and no fees will be paid in the event Rincon Consultants subsequently hires such individual. Rincon Consultants is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

description:

Havas Market**Job Description :**

**About Us:**

  

We are Havas Market, part of the Havas Media Group. Our mission is to create meaningful connections between people and brands to drive business success with one vision, one voice and one P\&L. Havas is the only truly integrated marketing and communications company in the UK.

  

Havas Market is Havas Media Group’s specialist ecommerce and performance marketing agency. Our 150\-strong team brings together data, performance marketing, connected commerce and retail expertise to help brands drive measurable commercial growth.


Our Limitless Performance proposition connects brand, performance, commerce and loyalty to create more joined\-up customer experiences and move people closer to purchase. We work across a range of channels, including:

* Direct\-to\-consumer (D2C) media
* Marketplaces
* Retail media
* Social commerce
* Loyalty \& Partnerships
  

Our offer spans managed services, consultancy, technology and tools, supporting clients across multiple markets and categories.


As part of Havas Group, we also benefit from access to a broad range of complementary capabilities, including media, data and technology, digital, social, CRM, UX, creative, research, public relations, design and more – all under one roof at our London Kings' Cross office.

 **The Role**


This role sits within the Havas Market Ecommerce Client Team.


As a Senior Ecommerce Executive, you will support the Ecommerce Manager in delivering high\-quality client service across a portfolio of connected commerce clients. You will contribute to campaign coordination, performance analysis, reporting, project management and client communications, helping to ensure smooth day\-to\-day delivery across your accounts.


Our clients operate across a range of channels, including:

* Brand: OOH, BVOD and programmatic
* Performance: PPC and paid social
* Commerce: Amazon retail, Amazon Ads, retail media and TikTok Shop
  

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious ecommerce or performance marketing executive who wants to develop broader experience across the connected commerce environment. You are not expected to have in\-depth knowledge of every channel. However, you should have a strong appetite to learn and an interest in understanding how different channels work together to deliver against brand and commercial objectives for clients.

  

The role would suit someone with one to two years’ agency experience in ecommerce and/or performance marketing who is ready to take the next step in a client\-facing role. This role is hybrid, with 3\-days a week (Usually Tues, Weds \& Thurs) at our central Kings Cross office, and 2 days remote.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **Client and campaign delivery**

* Support the Ecommerce Manager and Director in developing ecommerce strategies for clients.
* Contribute to campaign planning, annual planning and the development of ad hoc briefs.
* Build an understanding of clients’ businesses, customers and commercial objectives.
* Help ensure recommendations are practical, insight\-led and aligned with clients’ short\- and long\-term goals.
* Support the coordination of multi\-channel campaigns, working closely with internal activation teams.
* Schedule and coordinate internal stand\-ups, track actions and help ensure campaigns remain on schedule and on budget.
* Monitor campaign pacing and performance, escalating issues and performance challenges to the Ecommerce Manager where appropriate.
* Support the development of post\-campaign analyses (PCAs), ensuring they contain clear, actionable insights.
* Support the implementation of client innovation and testing roadmaps.
 **Planning and performance**

* Work with the Ecommerce Manager and activation teams to develop media plans, forecasts and performance benchmarks.
* Contribute to performance analysis across ecommerce, retail media and wider paid media channels.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance and client outcomes.
* Help anticipate potential delivery issues and recommend ways to mitigate them.
 **Client management**

* Own agreed client workstreams and support the day\-to\-day management of client accounts.
* Lead weekly client meetings with confidence; crafting clear agenda and performance inisghts
* Act as a reliable point of contact for campaign updates, actions and operational queries.
* Build strong working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Communicate clearly, proactively and professionally across all projects.
 **Reporting and tools**

* Own the preparation of weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Translate data into clear, actionable insights and challenge assumptions where appropriate.
* Support the post\-campaign analysis process by briefing internal teams, collating findings and preparing presentation materials.
* Become proficient in relevant ecommerce, retail media and performance marketing tools, including proprietary Havas Market technology.
 **Digital shelf optimisation**

* Optimise product content and ecommerce operations across relevant commerce platforms.
* Help improve clients’ retail presence, discoverability and commercial performance.
* Monitor issues relating to content, availability, retailer compliance and platform execution, escalating where required.
 **Skills and Experience**

* Ideally one to two years’ experience in an agency, brand, retailer or consultancy environment, ideally within ecommerce, retail media or performance marketing.
* An analytical mindset and strong Excel/spreadsheet skills.
* Experience with campaign coordination, reporting or performance analysis.
* Working knowledge of Amazon Ads and Amazon retail platforms, including Vendor Central and/or Seller Central.
* Understanding of retail media and marketplace activity.
* Experience or exposure to PPC and paid social activation.
* Strong organisational and project management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* The ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial agency environment.
* A collaborative, proactive and positive approach.
* A genuine interest in learning and developing across connected commerce.
 **Desirable Experience**

* Experience with both Amazon Vendor Central and Seller Central.
* Experience with TikTok Shop or social commerce.
* Familiarity with digital shelf metrics and optimisation.
* Experience with retail media networks or marketplace platforms beyond Amazon.
* Knowledge of ecommerce reporting or activation tools.
* Experience supporting new business, pitch or planning activity.

Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.


**Our Values**


**Customers**



We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.


**Action**



We make 'thoughtfully fast' decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.


**Team Spirit**



We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.


**Innovation**



We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.


**Excellence**



We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.

**About the Role**



The Marketing Director, Europe is a critical role responsible for building Billtrust's brand and demand generation engine across Europe from the ground up, in direct partnership with the CMO and cross\-functional leadership.



As part of scaling Billtrust across European markets, you will build go\-to\-market and brand awareness strategy in priority markets like the UK and Germany, develop market\-entry strategy for new geographies, and act as an embedded partner to regional sales, SDR, and CS teams.


**What You'll Do**


**Regional Strategy \& Leadership**


* Own the European marketing strategy and P\&L\-aligned plan, setting country/region priorities, targets, and budget allocation in direct support of pipeline and revenue goals set with the CMO and NA leadership.
* Develop market\-entry strategies for new European geographies, including sequencing, positioning, and channel selection.
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, making day\-to\-day regional decisions while keeping the NA\-based CMO aligned on strategy, budget, and results.
* Report on regional marketing performance, pipeline contribution, and awareness metrics to the CMO and broader leadership
* Manage regional marketing budget, forecasting, and vendor contracts.


**Go\-to\-Market \& Demand Generation**


* Build and execute a go\-to\-market and brand\-awareness strategy tailored to each priority European market, recognizing the company is largely unknown particularly in UK \& Germany, two top priority markets, and requires demand generation from a low\-awareness starting point.
* Localize and adapt content, messaging, and campaigns into local languages and cultural context rather than simply translating NA assets.
* Plan and activate regional events (field marketing, trade shows, roadshows) end\-to\-end, from budget and vendor selection through execution and ROI reporting.
* Run digital marketing (paid, SEO/SEM, social, web) localized by market, with performance tracked against pipeline and awareness KPIs.


**Partnerships, PR \& Cross\-Functional Execution**


* Manage regional PR and comms, including relationships with local PR agency, to build brand credibility and press presence market by market.
* Build and manage a partner marketing program with regional resellers/partners, including co\-marketing funds, joint campaigns, and enablement.
* Work as an embedded partner to regional sales leaders, sellers, SDRs, and CSMs despite a lean team, aligning marketing activity tightly to sales priorities and pipeline coverage.
* Tap resources in North America for Operations support, content creation, web needs, etc.
* Source, hire, and manage external contractors and agencies (creative, digital, PR, events) to extend capacity.


**What You'll Bring**


**Required Skills:**


* 8–10 years in B2B marketing, with several years in a European regional or country marketing leadership role.
* Track record building marketing in new or low\-awareness markets (brand\-building/market\-entry experience), not just scaling an already\-known brand.
* Experience spanning multiple channels: field/events, digital, content, PR — able to both strategize and execute hands\-on given a lean team.
* Proven ability to manage agencies and contractors effectively, essentially running an "extended team" model.
* Experience operating autonomously and cross\-functionally with sales, SDRs, and CS in a matrixed, remote\-from\-HQ structure (reporting to a NA\-based CMO).
* Multi\-market European experience (especially UK, DACH, Benelux) with cultural and localization fluency.
* Strong analytical/planning skills — able to set and report against KPIs tied to pipeline and awareness goals.
* Based in London.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced, resource\-constrained environment typical of scaling a US company into Europe.


**Preferred Skills:**


* Fintech (or B2B payments/financial software) background strongly preferred, with familiarity navigating European fintech buyer dynamics and competitive landscape.
* Partner/channel marketing experience strongly preferred.
* German language skills a plus in addition to fluent English.

At Billtrust, we believe your total rewards should reflect the impact you make. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health coverage, competitive retirement, generous PTO and parental leave, flexible work options, and meaningful investment in your professional development. We're building something special and we want you to feel supported while doing it.

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.


As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.


We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City (opening Summer 2026\), you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.


If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.


**The Team:**


Upstart's Lifecycle Marketing team is responsible for driving engagement and growth across the customer lifecycle for every Upstart product. The team develops and executes lifecycle strategies that help customers discover, adopt, and deepen their relationship with Upstart through personalized, data\-driven experiences across multiple owned channels.


As the Director of Lifecycle Marketing, you will lead the strategy, performance, and evolution of Lifecycle Marketing across Upstart's growing product portfolio. You'll oversee an experienced team of marketing leaders, shape the long\-term roadmap for the channel, and partner closely with Product, Analytics, Creative, Product Marketing, and Growth teams to drive meaningful business outcomes.

* Define and execute the long\-term Lifecycle Marketing strategy across Upstart's products and customer journeys.
* Lead and develop a high\-performing team of lifecycle marketing leaders, establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, and opportunities for growth.
* Own revenue and performance goals for Lifecycle Marketing, using experimentation, optimization, and automation to improve customer engagement and business results.
* Partner closely with Product, Analytics, Creative, Product Marketing, and Growth Marketing teams to prioritize initiatives and deliver customer experiences across email, push, SMS, in\-app messaging, and emerging channels.
* Establish scalable lifecycle infrastructure, governance, and measurement frameworks that support a growing portfolio of products and more complex customer journeys.
* Champion thoughtful adoption of AI and automation to improve lifecycle operations, accelerate experimentation, and increase team productivity while maintaining high quality standards.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of experience in B2C Lifecycle Marketing.
* 5\+ years of direct people management experience, including experience leading managers.

* Experience owning revenue\-driven Lifecycle Marketing programs with accountability for performance targets, experimentation, and measurable business growth.

title: Director Design, Product Design & AI (m/f/d)
description:
#### **This is Edenspiekermann**


We are Edenspiekermann, an independent design consultancy with 40\+ years of experience helping world\-leading organizations invent, build, and evolve their products.


Our interaction designers work in agile and interdisciplinary teams on websites and platforms for major brands as well as for startups. Our teams combine conceptual thinking, a sophisticated understanding of design and a deep knowledge of web and app development to develop a digital product or service with a user\-centric approach. In doing so, we advise and coach our clients' teams to provide the best customer experience for their customers.

#### **Description**


We are looking for a hands\-on Design Director to join our US team in a permanent, remote\-first role based in Southern California. You will work primarily from home and be available to travel to client sites across the United States as engagements require. You will lead complex digital\-product and design\-system engagements across our portfolio, including work in regulated industries and global medical technology. AI will be a core part of how you explore, prototype, make decisions, and help teams deliver better work.  

This is a senior client\-facing role for someone who is excited by how AI is changing design and product development. You will set direction, stay close to the work, and help clients move from isolated experiments to useful AI\-enabled products, workflows, and operating models. You will combine curiosity and speed with strong judgment about where human craft, review, and accountability matter.

#### **Your Tasks**

* Lead client engagements end\-to\-end, from initial framing and design direction through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Translate user needs, business goals, brand intent, accessibility, engineering, content, and compliance requirements into clear product and system direction.
* Own the design quality of the work, balancing strategic clarity with strong visual, interaction, and systems\-design craft.
* Direct the creation and evolution of scalable Figma libraries, component architectures, variables, tokens, themes, patterns, prototypes, and documentation.
* Work closely with product and engineering leaders to connect design decisions with production code, release processes, and measurable product outcomes.
* Establish practical governance and contribution models that support distributed teams without overloading a small central group.
* Facilitate workshops and decision\-making with senior stakeholders across design, product, engineering, research, content, and compliance.
* Guide multidisciplinary teams, coach designers, set a high bar for craft, and give clear, constructive direction.
* Make AI part of the design practice every day, using it for research synthesis, ideation, content, prototyping, design\-system work, and design\-to\-code exploration.
* Prototype AI\-enabled product experiences, including conversational, adaptive, generative, and agentic interactions, then test whether they create meaningful value for people.
* Experiment quickly with new tools and models, share what works, and help the team build repeatable AI workflows instead of one\-off demos.
* Evaluate AI output critically and establish practical guardrails for quality, accessibility, privacy, approved source material, human review, and accountability.
* Help shape Edenspiekermann's AI\-enabled product and design\-systems practice, contributing to how we pitch, deliver, and talk about the work.
#### **Your profile**

* You have at least 8 years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or design systems, including several years leading complex client or enterprise engagements.
* Your portfolio demonstrates systems thinking, refined visual craft, shipped digital products, and credible AI\-enabled work.
* You have led design systems across multiple products, platforms, brands, or teams and understand how they connect to Figma libraries, production code, documentation, versioning, and engineering adoption.
* You have experience in a regulated or high\-accountability environment and treat accessibility as a system requirement.
* You can lead senior client conversations, facilitate difficult decisions, and turn ambiguity into a practical path forward with curiosity, judgment, and a collaborative, low\-ego attitude.
* You actively use generative and agentic AI in your own practice, can demonstrate workflows beyond surface\-level prompting, and can separate useful applications from hype.
* You communicate fluently in English and are comfortable collaborating across US and European teams.
* You are based in Southern California, willing and able to travel to client sites across the United States as engagements require, and legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
#### **We Offer**

* A permanent, full\-time, remote\-first role with a central place in our US design team.
* The annual salary range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
* A defined contribution toward medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus access to a healthcare FSA.
* A 401(k) plan with a 2% company match and eligibility for a discretionary year\-end bonus based on company performance.
* A flexible PTO policy, with time off coordinated around client and team commitments, plus eleven paid holidays, a year\-end office closure, monthly internet and wellness stipends, and professional\-development support.
* The opportunity to lead visible, strategically important product, design\-system, and AI\-enabled transformation engagements.
* An international portfolio and regular collaboration with colleagues across Europe and the United States.
* A high\-craft, low\-ego team with direct access to partners and senior leadership, real autonomy, constructive feedback, and space to shape how we work.
* A multidisciplinary team that is actively building AI into design, strategy, research, engineering, and delivery.
#### **We are pleased to meet you!**


We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/beliefs, disability, age, and sexual orientation and identity.

**If you are interested, please provide us with the following documents and information:**

* Current CV
* Portfolio with at least one substantial product or design\-system case and a credible AI\-enabled product or workflow example
* A short explanation of your role, decisions, measurable contribution, and how AI changed the work or outcome
* Earliest possible start date


One more thing, never fear to apply initiative. We understand: a lack of confidence can sometimes keep us from applying for a job. But guess what?! There is no such thing as the perfect applicant. That's why we encourage you to apply to us.
